title: From Self to Other: Evaluating Demographic Perspective-Taking in LLM Hate Speech Annotation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating if gender-conditioned LLM personas (Men vs. Women) replicate human disagreement patterns, show in-group sensitivity when their identity is targeted, and accurately predict out-group perspectives in hate speech annotation.

Evaluating if race-conditioned LLM personas (White vs. Black) replicate human disagreement patterns, show in-group sensitivity when their identity is targeted, and accurately predict out-group perspectives in hate speech annotation.

Evaluating if religion-conditioned LLM personas (Christian vs. Atheist) replicate human disagreement patterns, show in-group sensitivity when their identity is targeted, and accurately predict out-group perspectives in hate speech annotation.
Evaluating if ideology-conditioned LLM personas (Liberal vs. Conservative) replicate human disagreement patterns and can accurately predict the opposing group's perspective in hate speech annotation.

Evaluating if sexuality-conditioned LLM personas (Straight vs. Gay) replicate human disagreement patterns, show in-group sensitivity when their identity is targeted, and accurately predict out-group perspectives in hate speech annotation.
